mapper.select: SELECT location_id, si_do, si_gun_gu, post_id, emotion_id, emoji, name FROM ( SELECT p.location_id, l.si_do, l.si_gun_gu, pet.post_id, et.id AS emotion_id, et.emoji, et.name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.location_id ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, pet.emotion_id DESC) AS rn FROM post_emotion_tag pet JOIN posts p ON p.id = pet.post_id AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN emotion_tags et ON et.id = pet.emotion_id JOIN locations l ON l.id = p.location_id ) ranked WHERE rn <= 5 ORDER BY location_id, rn
